name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.267.0 — readers keep only the surviving escape fields — the owed query, the amendment join, the review-survivor match fields and the unclassed-rows scan retire from the fleet reader, status and doctor; release routes a defect to /spec:fix; canonical pipeline and review prose elide the retired names. 7.266.0 — The escape command is deleted: a fix commit touching lines a reviewed spec landed records the escape row itself through /git:commit step 3 (one row per commit, class the only question), the escape row loses six derived fields, a red CI observation surfaces as a /spec:fix entry, and the review driver's done-spec refusal names /spec:fix; hosts re-stamp with /spec:doctor. 7.265.0 — Review close refuses any drift between the committed close tree and the judged tree, every time; softs are advisory debt written with the CLOSE verdict or ride a fix round the reviewer re-checks, and the post-verdict fix window, its line ceiling and its sweep mark are gone.
